mentions.name: News collection Airflow pipeline
mentions.description: This app is an Airflow pipeline focused on collecting news. It serves as a personal news collection tool and a learning platform: processing is initially done with a stronger LLM, results are saved, and the plan is to later attempt training a small language model (SLM) on the saved data.
mentions.audience: The author, for personal use and as a learning platform.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building my an airflow pipeline focused on collecting news.

Partly because I want one, but also because it makes for a good learning platform. e.g. initially do some of the processing with a stronger llm...save result and then attempt to train a SLM or similar
mentions.author: Havoc
